name: swatch-scroll-picker
description: 随滚动取色的色板收藏工具
interaction: As you scroll through any webpage, the tool live-samples the dominant color of the current viewport and spins it into a growing swatch ribbon beside the scrollbar. Click the ribbon at any moment to pin a color, building a personal palette that mirrors your journey through the page. Hover a pinned swatch to copy its hex code instantly.
